value.rationale: The four-arm theta is a canonical first high-valence extension of the classical three-arm theta and appears at the surface-braid threshold for three particles. This classification gives the full integral action under S4 arm permutations and pole exchange—not just the free rank—together with six geometric exchange-cycle generators and a computable unimodular basis. Such integral equivariant data distinguishes signed arm-pair transport and cannot be deduced from ordinary Betti numbers. It is a complete motivated finite natural invariant, not an arbitrary graph slice or routine rank recomputation.
